pages.title: An old park · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a golden afternoon in an old park in Boston. Tall trees make cool shadows on the grass. Grandpa Joe sits on a wooden bench. His grandson Ben runs over and sits next to him. The old man smiles and looks at the playground. He starts to remember the past.
“Come, Ben. Sit with me on the bench.” says Grandpa Joe. “Grandpa, tell me about your childhood.” says Ben. “I lived in a small house near this park.” says Grandpa Joe.

pages.title: Encontre a frase natural

opts: When I was a kid, I played.
When I be a kid, I played.
When I am a kid, I played.

items.why: After did, use the base verb.

pages.instruction: Escolha a forma que resolve a situação; explique o erro comum.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Escolha a frase mais natural. → I caught small fish.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → When I was a kid, I played.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → We played every day.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → Did you play baseball?
